sql_injection.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
sql_injection.remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements (e.g. PreparedStatement in Java, parameterized inputs in ORMs). Never concatenate user input directly into SQL strings. Implement input validation and least-privilege database user accounts.

cross_site_scripting.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
cross_site_scripting.remediation: Context-aware output encoding (HTML, JavaScript, CSS attributes), sanitize untrusted HTML using DOMPurify, enable Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers, and set HttpOnly flags on sensitive session cookies.

path_traversal.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
path_traversal.remediation: Validate path input against an explicit whitelist of permissible values. Use canonical path resolution (e.g. os.path.realpath / Path.resolve()) and ensure the target directory strictly resides within the approved root folder.

command_injection.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
command_injection.remediation: Avoid invoking shell commands with user-supplied arguments. Use platform-native APIs instead. If external process execution is mandatory, pass arguments as fixed lists without shell interpolation (e.g., shell=False in subprocess).

security_headers_missing.remediation: Configure HTTP response security headers in server or reverse-proxy middleware: 'Content-Security-Policy', 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN', 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff', and 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains'.

cookie_no_httponly.remediation: Set the 'HttpOnly' attribute on all authentication and session cookies to prevent client-side JavaScript access via XSS vulnerabilities. Ensure 'Secure' and 'SameSite=Lax/Strict' flags are also enforced.

cors_misconfiguration.remediation: Avoid using 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' with credentials. Validate incoming Origin headers against an explicit, trusted whitelist of authorized domains.

information_disclosure.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
information_disclosure.remediation: Disable verbose debug error stack traces in production environments. Suppress or randomize 'Server' and 'X-Powered-By' HTTP headers in reverse-proxy configuration.

csrf.remediation: Implement anti-CSRF synchronizer tokens for all state-changing HTTP requests (POST, PUT, DELETE). Utilize 'SameSite=Lax' or 'SameSite=Strict' on session cookies.

open_redirect.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
open_redirect.remediation: Avoid redirecting based on unvalidated user input. Maintain a static whitelist of valid destination paths or relative URLs.

default_mapping.remediation: Review the specific finding evidence, verify application security baseline configurations, and consult the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG).
